description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect From 2020.04.27 to 2020.05.03
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/commercial transactions related to customs, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure types. The mention of the Director General of Customs represents the authority issuing the regulation, not a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
